model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates the percentage of recycled materials—specifically Aluminum, Kupfer (Copper), and Nickel—in both Deutschland (Germany) and the EU across the years 2021, 2022, and 2023. The horizontal axis displays the material categories: Aluminum, Kupfer, and Nickel, listed alphabetically. The vertical axis represents percentage, labeled as “%”, with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 30, and tick marks at 5-unit intervals. For Deutschland, there are three bars for each material, representing 2021 (dark blue), 2022 (medium blue), and 2023 (light blue). In 2021, the percentages for Aluminum, Kupfer, and Nickel are approximately 3.6%, 8.3%, and 11.3% respectively, while in 2022 these values are 2.7%, 11.4%, and 24.7%, and in 2023 they are 1.0%, 2.2%, and 25.1%. The EU chart mirrors this structure, with the same color scheme and years represented. The EU percentages for 2021 are approximately 3.2%, 4.4%, and 5.1% for Aluminum, Kupfer, and Nickel, respectively, while in 2022 they are 1.7%, 2.8%, and 1.3%, and in 2023 they are 1.8%, 1.7%, and 14.6%. The bars within each material category are grouped by year, with 2021 appearing first, followed by 2022, and then 2023. No bars are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, outlines, or annotations.
